PF1AUTOHEAL.Setting.CheckRangeHint: When disabled, any targeted token is healed regardless of distance.

PF1AUTOHEAL.Setting.FeyDebugHint: Print whether the feat matched, how many dice, and the bonus.
PF1AUTOHEAL.Setting.DebugHint: Print range/distance decisions to the browser console.
